query: WITH city_population AS (SELECT TRIM(hl.city) AS city, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.id, hp.dependent_seq_no) AS population FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala AS hp JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location AS hl ON hp.id = hl.id WHERE hp.is_in_population = TRUE AND hp.snapshot = (SELECT MAX(snapshot) FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala) GROUP BY TRIM(hl.city) ORDER BY population DESC LIMIT 5), total_top5 AS (SELECT SUM(population) AS total FROM city_population) SELECT cp.city, cp.population, ROUND(cp.population * 100.0 / t.total, 2) AS percentage FROM city_population AS cp CROSS JOIN total_top5 AS t ORDER BY cp.population DESC LIMIT 1200
